full_judgment: 2. The suit was contested by defendant No. 1. The defence case inter alia is that there were charges against the plaintiff for misappropriation of huge amount of school fund, tempering and interpolation with the Books of Accounts but despite repeated requests he did not convene any meeting of the Managing Committee and a requisition meeting was convened on 21.6.76 where from the plaintiff was absent willfully and the meeting was adjourned till to 30.6.76 When on 30.6.76 the plaintiff attended the meeting and his verbal statements were heard but these were not found satisfactory. A charge sheet was issued against him. Thereafter, the plaintiff submitted his written statement and his statement was considered but found unsatisfactory and accordingly, he was served notice on 11.7.76 as to his termination and since then the plaintiff is not in service and the matter has been placed for approval of the Board and the decision is in process, that the plaintiff has been legally discharged and he has no legal right to institute any such suit as the relationship between the plaintiff and defendant is nothing but that of a master and servant for which a suit for damage only if any, would lie for breach of a contract.
